calibration_policy: reuse locked Q2 best parameters; never refit per event

information.annual: Q2 contemporaneous announced information and paid queues
information.event: Common unshocked pre-event dispatch without shock foreknowledge; event becomes visible at start_hour; identical remaining-window perfect foresight thereafter. Optimistic conditional information, not operational forecast skill.

parameter_identity: All SP/ST multipliers and event timing/severity are author conditional hypotheses, not empirically estimated policy or disaster parameters
event_rationale: Finite two-point mechanism exercise: moderate selection and longer/deeper held-out conditional stress. Separate versions required for changes after viewing results; no probabilistic coverage claimed.

safety.service_priority: retain Q2 priorities; report each service separately
safety.threshold_identity: author comparison bounds, not statutory reliability criteria

numerical.basis: Q2 settle() existing currency-balance tolerance; numerical policy fixed before Q3 results

h02.frozen_response: battery discharge cannot exceed matched S0 dispatch in each period
h02.retained: same physical assets, stocks, service requests, source envelopes and calendar
h02.interpret: only this specified storage response contribution, not all multi-energy propagation

revision_reason: V3 stopped after 73 annual cases: forecast timing did not veto current retirement; epsilon ranking lacked joint admissibility. V4 applies forecast before exit, enforces the unchanged common bounds, exports yearly constraints and reports bottlenecks. All physical/event/budget/grid values unchanged; all prior evidence retained. No blind validation claim.
test_identity: Already seen deeper condition, including V2 and V3 implementation checks; V4 is a disclosed scientific-method repair with unchanged stress/threshold values, not blind validation.
source_share_time_assumption: Hold the 2024 dimensionless source composition fixed in all conditional 2030 and 2060 event/planning snapshots; no observed future source capability claim.

transition.information: Current assets, paid/fully funded committed queues, current growth expectations and frozen selection plateau; no future realised state or test-event values in rules
transition.fixed_project_identity: Replay fixed_schedule full-response approved applications, revealed only in original decision years; all capital amounts, payment schedules, service-device mix and base permits identical; cash/finance failure invalidates fixed-set comparison
transition.deadline: Early-exit cohorts may defer only to min(original technical exit,2060); no new technical life extension
transition.planner_limit: Binding flags screen grid/storage action candidates. Conditional 24h plateau screen is separate from continuous-event outcome; unresolved fuel/device deficits remain risks.
transition.fixed_rule_tie: Cost order uses avoidable holding cost per MW then technical expiry; homogeneous coal cohorts can tie exactly with fixed schedule; never invent unit-level heterogeneity
transition.retirement_information_order: Commission paid assets, assess current and H-year committed-only pressure, THEN approve exit/paid finite retention, operate, request/approve/pay investments. Future realised states and unrevealed fixed applications are excluded.
transition.threshold_selection: Admissible only if every full-response selection grid cell meets the same policy service/carbon/gross-cost limits against its cell fixed-schedule comparator; then rank worst selection shortage, total net cost, epsilon. Return null if none; never replace admissibility with least-bad ranking.

policy.scope: Finite alternatives, no continuous/global optimality claim; equal annual appropriation ceiling, not mandatory equal expenditure
policy.no_feasible: Report none; sensitivity bounds never replace designated constraints
policy.selection: All candidates evaluated against annual services plus S0/SG/SW/SGW in selection event at 2030 and 2060; lock before deeper event evaluation
policy.test_identity: Already seen deeper condition, including V2 and V3 implementation checks; V4 is a disclosed scientific-method repair with unchanged stress/threshold values, not blind validation.

sensitivity_scope: Run each single-factor change for ALL eight fixed policy candidates; independent ranking with original constraints, no new policy search or retuning on test events. vR/vE/L and epsilon already have H01 grids.

compute_budget.rationale: 6 unique H01 cells x (3 controls+2 epsilon values) x 2 modes=60; 8 policy candidates + 6 one-factor grids x 8=56. All deterministic, no agent parallelism.
